parameters.name: ActiveAddressType
parameters.description:
The address type of the new database. Valid values:

- Public: public address
- Private: private network address

parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The remarks of the new database. The value can be up to 500 characters in length.

parameters.name: DatabaseName
parameters.description: The name of the new database instance. This parameter is required when the database source is **Local**.

parameters.name: DatabasePort
parameters.description: The port used to access the database. This parameter is required when the database source is **Local**.

parameters.name: DatabasePrivateAddress
parameters.description:
The private network address. IPv4 addresses and domain name formats are supported.
> This parameter is required when ActiveAddressType is set to Private.

parameters.name: DatabasePublicAddress
parameters.description:
The public address. IPv4 addresses and domain name formats are supported.
> This parameter is required when ActiveAddressType is set to Public.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceMemberId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the new ApsaraDB RDS or PolarDB database instance belongs.

parameters.name: NetworkDomainId
parameters.description:
The ID of the network domain to which the new database belongs.
> You can call the [ListNetworkDomains](~~2758827~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: PolarDBEndpointType
parameters.description:
The endpoint type of the PolarDB cluster. This parameter is required when Source is set to PolarDB. Valid values:
- Cluster: cluster endpoint
- Primary: primary endpoint

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the new database. Valid values:
- Local: self-managed database instance
- Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance
- PolarDB: PolarDB cluster

parameters.name: SourceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the new database.  
> This parameter is required when **Source** is set to **Rds** or **PolarDB**.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the new database instance.
> This parameter is required when **Source** is set to **Rds** or **PolarDB**.
